title.en: Cement does not replace what LZ-60 vs LZ-80 Concrete Pump lists
title.zh: 「水泥」不能替换LZ-60和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

description.en: LZ-60 vs LZ-80 Concrete Pump. 145 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Cement.
description.zh: LZ-60和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同。145 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「水泥」。

h1.en: Cement does not replace what LZ-60 vs LZ-80 Concrete Pump lists
h1.zh: 「水泥」不能替换LZ-60和LZ-80混凝土泵有何不同列出的数字

directAnswer.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. LZ-60 lists 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement.
directAnswer.zh: LZ-60 和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。LZ-60 标出 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、泵送压力 35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement: Cement. LZ-60 and LZ-80 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Theoretical output: LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h. low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Max. aggregate size: LZ-60 lists 4 cm and below. LZ-80 lists 6 cm and below. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Do not copy LZ-60's 300 m height into the LZ-80 entry that has no metre figure. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement页上的Cement。LZ-60 和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。理论输送量：LZ-60标出 50 m³/h；LZ-80标出 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。最大骨料粒径：LZ-60标出 4 cm and below；LZ-80标出 6 cm and below。LZ-60有、LZ-80没有的行：型号行 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132；发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

body.en: LZ-60 lists 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. Pumping pressure: LZ-60 lists 35 MPa. LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 35 MPa. low pressure ≤ 22 MPa. Total weight: LZ-60 lists 5500 kg. LZ-80 lists 6800 kg. LZ-60 lists entries that LZ-80 does not: Model line LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Engine power 6105 / 145 kW. Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm. Open /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60 and /en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-80.
body.zh: LZ-60 标出 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、泵送压力 35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m。泵送压力：LZ-60标出 35 MPa；LZ-80标出 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa。整机重量：LZ-60标出 5500 kg；LZ-80标出 6800 kg。LZ-80有、LZ-60没有的行：柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai)；料斗容积 0.6 m³；液压泵 Kawasaki double 140。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: LZ-80 lists 256 kW (Yuchai), high-pressure output ≤ 65 m³/h and low-pressure output ≤ 95 m³/h. Conveying distance: LZ-60 lists 100 m. LZ-80 lists 120 m. The same shown value on a shared label: Dimensions is 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m on both pages. LZ-80 lists entries that LZ-60 does not: Engine (diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai). Hopper capacity 0.6 m³. Hydraulic pump Kawasaki double 140. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: LZ-80 标出 256 kW（玉柴），高压产量 ≤ 65 m³/h，低压产量 ≤ 95 m³/h。输送距离：LZ-60标出 100 m；LZ-80标出 120 m。同一标题下数值相同的有：外形尺寸两边都是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。不要把 LZ-60 的 300 m 高度写进 LZ-80 那个没有米数的格子。

body.en: Its delivery height entry reads consult factory standard, which is not a metre value. Delivery height: LZ-60 lists 300 m. LZ-80 lists Consult factory standard. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 它的输送高度写着咨询工厂标准，这不是一个米数。输送高度：LZ-60标出 300 m；LZ-80标出 Consult factory standard。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，看LZ-80请打开 /zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/。

question.en: Does LZ-60 list the same theoretical output as LZ-80?
question.zh: LZ-60和LZ-80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. LZ-80 lists High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h. low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60标出 50 m³/h。LZ-80标出 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is model line missing on LZ-80?

answer.en: The LZ-80 page does not list that label. LZ-60 lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement.
answer.zh: LZ-80这一页没有标出这个标题。LZ-60标出的是 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cement画面里印出的数字。
